preconditions.name: commitment_and_completion_engaged
preconditions.description: ON arm committed (total_beta_elevated > 0) AND reached completions (n_sequence_completions > 0) on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds, so closure had a hook-based opportunity to fire.
preconditions.control: fraction of guard-passing seeds with ON commitment AND completions.

preconditions.name: residue_field_populated_at_closure
preconditions.description: ON arm residue_active_peak >= 1 (the residue field accumulated active RBF centers) on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds, so discharge_domain has in-domain centers to act on. The 466d empty-field artifact reads residue_active_peak = 0 and self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue here.
preconditions.control: update_residue wired into the residue-priming pass + eval loop; active_mask.sum() is the SAME quantity discharge_domain gates on (field.py:671).

contact_guard.definition: per-seed P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4; < 2/3 seeds -> substrate_not_ready_requeue.

residue_non_vacuity_gate.definition: ON residue_active_peak >= 1 on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory, non_degenerate=False), NEVER a false weakens. Detects the 466d empty-field artifact: discharge_domain returns 0 on an empty active_mask (field.py:671) regardless of closure behaviour.

completion_non_vacuity_gate.definition: ON total_beta_elevated > 0 AND n_sequence_completions > 0 on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue.
